group-mock-gd-2026-m1-seven-choices.overview: 说明文。解释拒绝敏感性：日常小事会被读成针对自己，回避又可能真的招来拒绝；随后给出挑战第一反应、坦诚表达需求、温暖回应他人三条习惯。

discourseStructure.summary: 开篇用未回信息等场景引出拒绝敏感；第二段定义并写自我保护造成距离；后三段以祈使小标题给出调节办法。

units.summary: 用朋友不回消息、路人没注意到你引出：对拒绝敏感的人会把小事看得很重。
定义拒绝敏感，写过度解读与回避，并指出距离感可能造成他们害怕的拒绝。

units.heading: Challenge your first reaction.
units.summary: 建议暂停最坏解释，写下中性可能。

units.heading: Express your needs openly.
units.summary: 指出隐藏感受的问题，建议清楚友善地表达。

units.heading: Respond warmly when others show care
units.summary: 别人伸出手时用微笑、短回等小动作欢迎连接。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: for those who are sensitive to rejection, these small moments feel heavy.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Rejection sensitivity means often expecting others to reject you

mechanismSignals.signalText: assume something is wrong with them
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项立刻觉得自己有问题，承接空前小事很沉重的感受。

mechanismSignals.targetText: assume something is wrong with them
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后定义拒绝敏感，与选项的自我否定解读同场。

optionFit.fitSummary: F 把“小事很沉重”具体化为立刻认为自己有问题，并接到下段对拒绝敏感的定义。

matchedClues.optionSide: immediately assume something is wrong with them
matchedClues.relation: 沉重感受落到自我否定的即时解读上。

keyDistractors.reason: D 说他们总在找办法缓解焦虑，空位需要的是对小事的即时解读，不是缓解策略。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-036.teachingNote: 段末空看空后是否开始下定义：F 的自我否定正好接到 Rejection sensitivity means。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: they try to protect themselves by avoiding eye contact keeping quiet, or pulling away.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: sometimes creating the very rejection they were afraid of.

mechanismSignals.relation: this distance 回指回避、沉默、拉开距离。

mechanismSignals.targetText: creating the very rejection they were afraid of
mechanismSignals.relation: 显得冷漠不友好，解释回避如何招来他们害怕的拒绝。

optionFit.fitSummary: E 用 this distance 承接回避行为，并说明这种距离让人显得冷漠，从而造成真拒绝。

matchedClues.optionSide: this distance can make them seem cold or unfriendly
matchedClues.relation: 拉开距离就是 this distance。

keyDistractors.reason: A 是追求更强联结，与正在写的自我保护、拉开距离方向相反。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-037.teachingNote: 空后破折号解释结果时，优先选能回指回避行为并说明负面印象的句子。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: When your mind jumps to the worst explanation pause and ask: What else could this mean?
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Try writing down at least two neutral (中性的) possibilities before accepting the negative one.

mechanismSignals.relation: 忙、有压力、分心是中性可能的实例。

mechanismSignals.targetText: the other person is busy, stressed, or simply distracted
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前追问还能是什么意思，选项给出另一种解释。

optionFit.fitSummary: G 提供中性替代解释，回答 What else could this mean，并接到写下两种中性可能。

matchedClues.optionSide: Perhaps the other person is busy, stressed, or simply distracted
matchedClues.relation: Perhaps 引出另一种可能，正是中性解释。

keyDistractors.reason: F 是立刻觉得自己有问题，属于最坏解释，与本段要挑战的第一反应同向。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-038.teachingNote: 问句 What else 后面通常跟替代解释，G 的 Perhaps 最贴。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: People with rejection sensitivity often hide their feelings, hoping others will understand without being told.

mechanismSignals.relation: But 转折：隐藏感受带来的沉默会造成困惑。
不说出口就是沉默，与希望别人自己懂相对。

optionFit.fitSummary: B 用 But 指出沉默造成困惑，从而引出后面清楚说出来的建议。

matchedClues.relation: 隐藏感受即沉默，其代价是困惑。

keyDistractors.reason: C 是温暖回应别人关心，属于下一段小标题，不是本段“表达需求”的转折。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-039.teachingNote: 隐藏感受与坦诚表达之间需要转折句，优先看 But。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Honest communication builds trust and reduces unnecessary worry.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: If someone reaches out to you, offer a small sign of openness

mechanismSignals.signalText: Respond warmly when others show care
mechanismSignals.targetText: If someone reaches out to you, offer a small sign of openness
mechanismSignals.relation: 别人伸出手时温暖回应，概括本段建议。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Respond warmly when others show care
mechanismSignals.relation: 欢迎连接与温暖回应同属主动接纳关心。

optionFit.fitSummary: C 是祈使小标题，概括“别人关心时给予开放信号”。

matchedClues.contextSide: offer a small sign of openness
matchedClues.optionSide: Respond warmly when others show care
matchedClues.relation: 小标题与段内建议句式一致。

keyDistractors.reason: A 追求更强联结偏结果口号，不如 C 直接对应 reaches out / show care。

q-mock-gd-2026-m1-040.teachingNote: 段首空且后文是 If someone reaches out，优先选同形的祈使小标题。
